node.title: Re^3: Almost certainly a module documentation issue
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
while isn't IO::Handle anywhere, and duplicates the FileHandle shown in the original code

It's an object of type [doc://IO::Handle], as shown in the first line of the dump. Basically IO::Handle->new boils down to [doc://bless]ing a new symbol as returned by [doc://Symbol]::gensym (which explains the second line of the dump) into the class IO::Handle ([https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/blob/bdd843170:/dist/IO/lib/IO/Handle.pm#l312|source]). If you step through the code, you should see the following:

**Before** the open() 0 IO::Handle=GLOB(0x1948fb2) -> *Symbol::GEN0 **After** the open() 0 IO::Handle=GLOB(0x1948fb2) -> *Symbol::GEN0 FileHandle({*Symbol::GEN0}) => fileno(7)

So the [doc://FileHandle] appears to be the result of [doc://open]ing the file.
